From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: procurement@orbito.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbito vendor onboarding: legal entity & PO routing

Hi Sofia / Orbito procurement team,

Thanks for engaging with Redwood — excited to get Orbito set up in our vendor registry so we can route POs and process the first statement-of-work. To keep things moving on our side, can you please provide the following items (or upload them into the secure portal linked below):

- Legal entity name exactly as registered
- Entity type (Corporation / LLC / Partnership / Sole proprietor)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT number if outside US)
- Registered address (street, city, state, postal code, country)
- Primary AP contact (name, title, email, phone)
- Preferred remit email for invoice delivery
- ACH details for US payments (bank name, routing number, account number) or instructions for wire
- Completed W-9 (US vendors) or W-8BEN / equivalent if non-US
- Copy of bank authorization letter or voided check for ACH setup
- Any PO requirement notes (are PO numbers required on invoices? mandatory for >$X thresholds?)

I attached our onboarding workbook to speed things up: Redwood_VENDOR_ONBOARDING_Sept2025.xlsx (please fill the yellow fields). If you prefer to send PDFs, that works too — just mark which file is the legal name / tax form / bank auth.

A few operational details from our side:
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (we can discuss if you need different cadence)
- PO policy: POs are generated for engagements >$5,000; services under that amount can be submitted as invoice-only unless otherwise negotiated
- Please confirm who should be copied on PO issuance (we normally send to the AP contact + procurement@orbito.com)

Can you aim to return the documents by EOD next Tuesday (2025-09-16)? Happy to set up a quick call if you’d rather walk through the workbook together.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_VENDOR_ONBOARDING_Sept2025.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

Quick answers to your questions:
- Legal entity: Orbito Systems, Inc.
- Entity type: C-Corporation (Delaware)
- EIN: 12-3456789
- Registered address: 210 Mission St, Suite 470, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
- AP contact: Daniel Reed, Finance Manager — daniel.reed@orbito.com, +1 (415) 555-2233

Ava / Marissa — looping in finance ops context and a couple of asks from my side before I route for final approval:

1) Can procurement classify Orbito as: 
   - Category: Software / SaaS (preferred)
   - Tax status: Vendor (domestic corporate)

2) ERP mapping: please confirm the preferred GL code for subscription vs professional services so we can set two default PO lines. If no preference, we'll use 6005 (Cloud services) for subscription and 6102 (Consulting) for services.

3) PO enforcement: If the vendor prefers PO-on-invoice for consulting work, that requires us to hold off on automated supplier invoice processing until the PO is issued. Confirm whether the vendor is able to accept invoice processing without a PO for < $5k engagements (we can waive PO on a per-case basis).

4) Risk/terms: do we require vendor to sign our standard supplier agreement for first engagement? I put a placeholder in the vendor record; Marissa — are you able to confirm the redline tolerance (standard vs. finance-approved exceptions)?

If finance needs an expedited first payment (e.g., to cover implementation hours), note that we can push payment via ACH once bank authorization is verified.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Procurement Strategy
jonas.weber@redwood.com
